result:
I fixed F-DG6-400. The executive pack's "Current metrics" and the executive dashboard's Value area now show "Includes restricted records" / "يشمل سجلات مقيدة" to a reader who isn't admitted to a sensitive record behind the figures. That holds live and in stored snapshots. Every required check ran and exited 0, and the changes are left uncommitted.

**Handback path:** the assignment said to write the handback to the `T-DG6-BE-Z8` path, but an earlier task's handback and evidence already live there. I wrote mine to `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG6/T-DG6-BE-Z9-backend-workflow-engineer.md`, with logs in `T-DG6-BE-Z9-evidence/`. Move it if the Z8 path was really intended.

**Fix**
- **Cause:** a section was only flagged from the records it names itself. These metrics sections name only their transformation or workstream, yet their values include the sensitive benefit's.
- **Decided from the aggregate:** each report now declares the records its totals include, and the flag is decided from those. The figures are identical for every reader.
- **Storage:** migration `0126_p6_report_snapshot_aggregate.sql` adds an append-only table for those records. Stored snapshot content and its checksum are unchanged.
- **Older snapshots:** snapshots stored before 0126 are labelled conservatively. Any benefit or business case marked sensitive in the transformation counts, so they can over-label but never under-label.
- **No new endpoints**, so the pending-operations list is unchanged.

**Sweep of all 12 report types**

| Report | Section | Finding |
|---|---|---|
| Executive pack | Current metrics (per subject) | Fixed (the reported case) |
| Executive dashboard | Value area | Fixed (the reported case) |
| Executive dashboard | Portfolio items table | Fixed, newly found: each initiative's planned value is built from its allocated benefits, and with a full share it equals the sensitive benefit's amount |
| Gate pack | Criteria table | Fixed, newly found: the unverified-evidence count includes evidence items the row doesn't name |
| All others | All sections | No aggregate over a sensitive record that the section doesn't already reference; unchanged |

**Tests:** I ported the domain probe and recorded runs before and after the fix.

| Test | Before fix | After fix |
|---|---|---|
| API (9 new tests added to `sensitive-reach-dashboards-reports.test.ts`) | 7 fail | 17/17 pass |
| Screen, real stack, en and ar (`apps/web/e2e/p6-report-aggregate-label.spec.ts`) | Fails in both: no label | 2/2 pass |

The 3 API tests that passed before the fix only check the new migration's database guards. The new spec's budget is 120 s; it took 13.1 s at worst under load. I also added a metrics-section case to the existing web label test (10/10).

**Checks**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `validate.mjs --historical --stage DG5` (start and end) | exit 0 |
| `pnpm -r typecheck`, `pnpm -r build`, `pnpm lint`, prettier, `pnpm openapi:lint` | exit 0 |
| `pnpm test`, locale unset and `C.UTF-8` | exit 0, same counts in both: 2899 + 2064 + 259 tests (2 skipped) |
| 82 integration files, including all the mandated ones | 820 pass, 1 skipped |
| `e2e/a22-p6-operability` and `e2e/a13-automation-recovery`, en and ar | 6/6 pass |

The first `pnpm test` run failed in 2 module-boundary tests: they rejected a lookup style I had used. I fixed it and re-ran both locales in full; the failing log is kept. The 3 skips are existing conditional skips, unrelated to this change.

**Left for others (details in the handback)**
- **Contract text:** the OpenAPI description of the section flag needs one added clause. No schema change.
- **Architect documents:** the data dictionary, ERD, ADR-0045, and the ADR-0051 sentence the reviewer flagged.
- **Exports:** exported files carry no restricted label for any section, including the table totals fixed earlier. Whether they should needs a design decision. Refusing the export would contradict the existing rule, because aggregates are visible to every reader.
- **Verification:** the domain reviewer still needs to verify the fix.
